result:
The draft needs one change before it goes out.

- **"Subscribers can pause or cancel any time"** matches the approved claim in section 2, so it is fine.
- **"free UK delivery on orders over £25"** matches the approved wording, so it is fine.
- **"means most boxes ship free"** is the problem. The policy has no proof of what share of orders or boxes pass the £25 threshold. Saying "most" implies a statistic we haven't verified, and it stretches the shipping policy beyond its wording. Remove it, or end the sentence after "orders over £25".
- **Voice and spelling:** The tone is warm, plain and unhurried. It uses no banned words and no health, green, urgency or guarantee claims, and it needs no disclosure label.

A suggested fix: "Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25."

This still needs Sam's approval, as all public content does.
